evals.name: java-ddd-with-testing-md
evals.prompt: Write unit tests for the `AddAssetUseCase` class. The project is at /tmp/eval-java-project. The class is at src/main/java/com/example/inventory/application/usecase/AddAssetUseCase.java
evals.expected_output: Skill loads TESTING.md first, shows preview with test names + locations before writing, applies builder/in-memory/NativeGenerators conventions from TESTING.md

assertions.text: Skill explicitly reads TESTING.md before writing any test
Generated tests use in-memory adapters instead of mocks
Generated tests use NativeGenerators for UUID generation
Test file is placed in src/test/java matching the source package structure

evals.name: typescript-no-conventions
evals.prompt: Add unit tests for a React hook called `useUserProfile` in a TypeScript project. The project is at /tmp/eval-ts-project and has no TESTING.md or rules/ folder. The hook fetches user data from an API and manages loading/error states.
evals.expected_output: Skill detects no convention files, proposes to create TESTING.md and/or rules/, infers conventions from existing tests if any, shows preview before writing

assertions.text: Skill detects that no TESTING.md or rules/ folder exists and explicitly notifies the user
Skill offers to create TESTING.md and/or rules/ independently
Skill correctly identifies TypeScript/React as the target language and framework

evals.name: python-rules-folder-only
evals.prompt: Test the `calculate_discount` function in a Python project. The project is at /tmp/eval-python-project which has a rules/ folder at the root with a testing-conventions.md file inside, but no TESTING.md. The function applies percentage discounts with minimum order validation.
evals.expected_output: Skill loads rules/testing-conventions.md, applies those conventions, shows preview, generates pytest-style tests respecting the rules

assertions.text: Skill scans and loads all .md files from the rules/ folder
Skill does not create a TESTING.md since rules/ already exists
Generated tests follow the conventions specified in rules/testing-conventions.md
Generated tests cover nominal path, invalid input, and boundary values
